_help: Act 8, the coast route (event chariot_chase): the chariot of the dead; after this talk, the chase (chariot_chase scene). Anyone in a truck that is destroyed dies (act8.gd: kill). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act89.py.

start.speaker: player
start.line: Dust behind us on the coast road, coming far too fast for any horse. Then the sound of wheels that don't touch the ground.

r_naguib.speaker: naguib
r_naguib.line: Drop the spare crates! Every pound is speed now!

r_farid.speaker: farid
r_farid.line: There is no price for this. There is no price at all. Drive!

r_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
r_hargreaves.line: Rifles out the back! Aim for the horses, if they are horses!

r_isabelle.speaker: isabelle
r_isabelle.line: Get me alongside it. I want to see its face.

come.speaker: player
come.line: A chariot of black wood and gold, drawn by things that were horses three thousand years ago. He raises a spear.
